sentences.en: She gave in to peer pressure and started smoking.
sentences.zh: 她屈服于同伴压力，开始抽烟了。

sentences.en: He refused to join the clique despite the intense peer pressure.
sentences.zh: 尽管有强大的同伴压力，他拒绝加入那个帮派。

sentences.en: The new student felt isolated because of the strong peer pressure in the group.
sentences.zh: 新来的学生因为团体中强烈的同伴压力而感到孤立无援。
